name: @thunder-solution/sdk
description: Official Thunder SDK for JavaScript and TypeScript: verify Thai bank and TrueMoney Wallet slips, generate payment QR codes and check webhook signatures.
author: Thunder Solution Co., Ltd.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir=dist/esm && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && bun -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }))"
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --banner='"use strict";' --outdir=dist/cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && bun -e "fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
scripts.check:package: bun pm pack --dry-run && publint run --strict && bun pm pack --filename=check-package.tgz && attw check-package.tgz; status=$?; rm -f check-package.tgz; exit $status
